description: Resolve a PENDING copy intent (from get_executions) by recording how you handled it. action:"acted" records that you executed the mirrored trade from your own wallet — optionally with the on-chain tx_signature for your records; action:"dismissed" discards the intent without trading. NON-CUSTODIAL: this never signs, sends, or broadcasts a transaction — it only updates the intent's status after YOU traded. Not idempotent: it transitions pending → acted/dismissed once; an intent that already expired or was actioned returns "not_actionable". Returns the updated execution. Requires THREE_WS_API_KEY.

action.description: "acted" = you executed the trade yourself; "dismissed" = you skipped it.

id.description: UUID of the pending copy intent (from get_executions with status:"pending").

tx_signature.description: Optional Solana transaction signature of your fill, recorded only when action="acted".

name: record_execution
title: Record acting on a copy intent
